source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?sold ?released WHERE { { SELECT ?item (MAX(?n) AS ?sold) (MIN(?d) AS ?released) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q7889 ; wdt:P2664 ?n . FILTER(?n >= 20000000) OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P577 ?d } } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 82
